items.stem: In a town of 10,000 people, 200 already have a chronic condition and 50 new cases arise during the year. The number that best represents incidence is:

options.rationale: Correct: incidence counts new cases arising over a period; prevalence would be the 200 existing cases.
That is prevalence, the existing cases, not incidence.
That mixes new and existing cases and is neither a clean incidence nor prevalence figure.
That is the population at risk, the denominator, not the incidence count.

items.explanation: Correct: incidence counts new cases arising over a period; prevalence would be the 200 existing cases.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: To investigate a rare disease by comparing past exposures of people with and without the disease, the most efficient design is:

options.rationale: Correct: case-control studies are efficient for rare diseases, comparing exposures retrospectively.
A cohort following people forward is inefficient for a rare disease because few would develop it.
An RCT assigns exposure and is not used to study a naturally occurring rare disease this way.
An ecological study uses population-level data and cannot link individual exposure to individual disease.

items.explanation: Correct: case-control studies are efficient for rare diseases, comparing exposures retrospectively.

items.stem: Which TWO conditions must hold for herd immunity to protect an unvaccinated person? (Select TWO)

options.text: A high enough proportion of the population is immune
options.rationale: Correct: once immunity passes the threshold, transmission chains break and the susceptible are indirectly protected.

options.text: The disease spreads from person to person
options.rationale: Correct: herd immunity applies to communicable diseases transmitted between people.

options.text: The disease is non-infectious and genetic
options.rationale: Herd immunity does not apply to non-communicable, non-transmissible conditions.

options.text: Immunity lasts only a single day
options.rationale: Very short-lived immunity would not sustain the population-level protection herd immunity requires.

items.explanation: Correct: once immunity passes the threshold, transmission chains break and the susceptible are indirectly protected.
